description: Window controls for the frameless SoundTube window. The UI is served by the local HTTP server, so that origin must be allowed explicitly: otherwise Tauri treats it as remote and rejects start_dragging/minimize/toggle_maximize/close. The app's own LAN commands (get_lan_mode/set_lan_mode, autogenerated by tauri-build from build.rs) need the same explicit allow for that origin.
